Odishika Abigail Adoh

Odishika Abigail Adoh is a Senior HR Executive whose work spans people operations, organisational culture, talent management and HR analytics. Her approach brings together professional rigour, empathy and a clear understanding of how people practices influence business outcomes.

With an international learning perspective and a strong interest in the future of work, she is committed to building organisations that are both high-performing and deeply human.
